dict.string: Mirna uses your microphone to record your voice during meetings and voice notes. Audio stays on this Mac.
Mirna uses system audio to record the other people in your meetings. Audio stays on this Mac.
Mirna uses your contacts to match calendar attendees with names and email addresses saved on your Mac.
Mirna reads your calendar to name and prepare your meetings.
Mirna uses your reminders to sync and manage tasks.
Mirna uses your local network to receive recordings from your paired phone and to reach model servers on your network, such as Ollama.
